system.description:
Anoints a willing person so that one Work, or all the Works of an Art, functions better on them for a week or more. A critical failure leaves them with a thematic drawback for the duration.

Spell. Challenging (9) to attune to one Work, Hard (15) to a whole Art; +3 per extra week (up to a month). Touch a willing target: 1–4 degrees give +1, +2, +1B or +1D to Spellcasting or Unleashing with that magic for a week.

Art of Benediction — full rules: Sword Chronicle p. 91.
system.resonances: Specially prepared ointments and unguents (30 silver drachmas).
